title: Systems Not Goals
hook: Everyone has the same goal. Winners built the machine that gets there.
explainer: A decent system run daily beats a perfect one run on vibes.
sop: Turn one goal into a daily system.
Score System Quality and Consistency 1 to 10.
Track only whether you ran it.
equation_example: System Quality 6 × Consistency 9 = 54. Steady beats brilliant and abandoned.
question: Write down one goal and its daily system.
closing_statement: Build the machine. The goal follows.
